title: 第662章 秦皓定三杀第661章 赵辛怒护徒
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
“老师。”
秦皓缓步走出，站到赵辛身侧，微微颔首，“多谢老师赶来。不过这约定，我确实应下了。”
“你确定？”赵辛眉头一拧，侧头看他：“圣墟境全力一击，可不是闹着玩的。”
“老师觉得，我算天才吗？”
秦皓忽然笑了笑，抬眼问道。
“废话。”
赵辛毫不犹豫，“天纹者都不算天才，九州就没天才了。”
他心里还补了一句，更何况你那过目成诵、抬手便能铭纹的本事，何止是天才，简直是妖孽啊。
自上次分别回山，他时不时就想起秦皓铭纹的过程，越想越心惊。
若不是亲眼所见，他根本不信有人能把图纹铭纹得那般轻松。
所以当他接到消息，说屈祁修带人找秦皓麻烦时，他瞬间酒醒，直接冲到焚川州。
谁敢动他这宝贝徒弟，他就跟谁玩命。
秦皓闻言，嘴角笑意更深了些。“多谢老师夸奖。其实……我也没怎么觉得我是天才。”
“我等生在荒古州，与天争命，与兽夺食。山海部能一步一步走到今天，凭的只有一个字。”
“狠。”
他抬起眼，血瞳中那片平静的琥珀色湖面终于开始翻涌。
从岩牛部灭族之夜，到误入“居虚倅略”、白骨禁地、黑金部围城，再从赤漠州追杀到焚川州围猎。
每一次生死一线，每一次以命搏命，他都没有真正释放过这股压在心底最深处的杀意。
但此刻，这个字从他嘴里吐出来时，一股滔天杀意轰然爆发。
那杀意没有神念和气血的加持，是纯粹原始、从尸山血海里泡出来的杀戮之气。

在场的焚宇部残兵们只觉得一股寒意从脚底板直冲天灵盖，浑身的汗毛根根竖起。
“好重的杀气！”
屈祁修面色骤变，远处围观的探子们齐齐倒吸一口凉气，一些胆小的更是双腿打着哆嗦，不敢动弹。
“伤我山海部者，杀！”
“辱我山海部者，杀！”
“挡我山海部者，杀！”
三个杀字，一道比一道沉，一道比一道冷。
秦浩那股在居虚倅略中，在那无尽的血海中淬炼出来的杀意，此刻终于毫无保留地释放。
与此同时，在他身后，山海部众人虽然被闻人放舟的压制力锁着无法动弹，但他们的杀意在同一时刻爆发。
尤其是那些拥有血瞳的族人，他们的杀意混在一起，与秦皓的杀意遥相呼应。
战场上所有人都被这股杀意震住了，有人颤声喃喃：“他们到底经历过什么……怎么会有如此暴虐的杀气？”
有人腿肚子都在打颤，“他才多大年纪，到底杀过多少人？”
这不是一个人，是一整个部落的杀意，这是一群从地狱里爬出来的亡魂共同散发出的，对这个世界所有敢挡在他们面前之人的纯粹杀机。
就连赵辛和闻人放舟都眼眸微动，神色不约而同地严峻了几分。
秦皓冷冷地看着屈祁修，忽然笑了。
“屈长老好像误会了一件事。”
秦皓抬眼看向半空的屈祁修，嘴角带着淡笑，“今日不是你看在同门面子上，给我一个机会。是我看在同门情分上，给你们焚宇部一个机会。”
血瞳缓缓从屈祁修脸上移开，落在那个被神念包裹、浑身浴血的屈屠身上，“当然作为交换，在那之后，你也要接我一招。”
此话一出，全场哗然，外围的探子们瞬间炸开了锅。
“他说什么？让圣墟境接他一招？他能活下来？”

“疯了吧！一个脱凡境，跟圣墟境互接一招？”
content_en:
"Teacher."
Qin Hao walked out slowly, stood beside Zhao Xin, and nodded slightly, "Thank you, teacher, for coming. But I did agree to this agreement."
"Are you sure?" Zhao Xin frowned and looked sideways at him: "A full-force attack from the Holy Ruins realm is no joke."
"Does the teacher think I'm a genius?"
Qin Hao suddenly smiled, raised his eyes and asked.
"Bullshit."
Zhao Xin did not hesitate, "No one with a sky pattern is considered a genius. There are no geniuses in Kyushu."
He added in his mind, not to mention your ability to memorize memories and engrave words with just a raise of your hand. You are not only a genius, but also a monster.
Since the last time he returned to the mountain, he had thought about the process of Qin Hao's inscription from time to time, and the more he thought about it, the more frightened he became.
If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, he wouldn't have believed that someone could inscribe patterns so easily.
So when he received the news that Qu Qixiu was bringing people to trouble Qin Hao, he instantly woke up and rushed directly to Fenchuan Prefecture.
He will risk his life for anyone who dares to touch his precious apprentice.
When Qin Hao heard this, his smile deepened. "Thank you for the compliment, teacher. Actually... I don't really think I'm a genius."
"We were born in a deserted ancient state, fighting against the sky for our lives, and fighting for food from the beasts. The Shanhai Department can reach today step by step, relying on only one word."
"Hard."
He raised his eyes, and the calm amber lake in his blood pupils finally began to surge.
From the night when the Yanniu Tribe was exterminated, to accidentally entering the "Juxu Lue", the Forbidden Land of Bones, and the siege of the Black Gold Tribe, and then from the Chimo Prefecture to the Fenchuan Prefecture for hunting.
Every time he was on the line between life and death, every time he fought for his life, he never really released the killing intent deep in his heart.
But at this moment, when this word came out of his mouth, a monstrous murderous intention burst out.
The murderous intention was not blessed by spiritual thoughts or blood. It was pure primitive killing energy bubbled from the sea of ​​blood in the mountain of corpses.
The remnants of the Fenyu tribe present felt a chill from the soles of their feet to the sky, and the hairs all over their bodies stood up.
"What a murderous aura!"
Qu Qixiu's expression suddenly changed, and the spies watching from a distance all took a breath of cold air. Some of the timid ones even had their legs trembling and did not dare to move.
"Anyone who hurts our Shanhai tribe will be killed!"
"Anyone who insults our Shanhai tribe will be killed!"
"Anyone who stands in the way of our Shanhai tribe will be killed!"
The three words "kill" are each heavier than the last, and each is colder than the last.
Qin Hao's killing intent, which was tempered in Juxu's strategy and in the endless sea of ​​blood, was finally released without reservation at this moment.
At the same time, behind him, although everyone in the Shanhai Department was locked and unable to move by Wenren Fangzhou's suppressive force, their murderous intent broke out at the same moment.
Especially those tribesmen with blood pupils, their murderous intentions were mixed together, echoing Qin Hao's murderous intentions.
Everyone on the battlefield was shocked by this murderous intent. Some people trembled and murmured: "What on earth have they experienced... How could they have such violent murderous intent?"
Someone's calves were trembling, "How old is he and how many people has he killed?"
This is not the murderous intent of one person, but of an entire tribe. It is the pure murderous intent emanating from a group of dead souls crawling out of hell against anyone in this world who dares to stand in front of them.
Even Zhao Xin and Wen Ren Fangzhou's eyes moved slightly, and their expressions invariably became a little more serious.
Qin Hao looked at Qu Qixiu coldly and suddenly smiled.
"Elder Qu seems to have misunderstood something."
Qin Hao raised his eyes and looked at Qu Qixiu in the air, with a faint smile on his lips, "Today it's not you who gave me a chance out of the sake of my fellow disciples. It's me who gave you Fenyu Department a chance out of the sake of our fellow disciples' friendship."
The blood pupils slowly moved away from Qu Qixiu's face and landed on Qu Tu, who was wrapped in spiritual thoughts and covered in blood. "Of course in exchange, after that, you will also take one of my moves."
As soon as these words came out, the whole place was in an uproar, and the spies on the periphery instantly exploded.
"What did he say? Let the Holy Ruins Realm take his attack? Can he survive?"
"Go crazy! A person in the transcendental realm, exchanging moves with the holy ruins realm? "
